tests.detail: src/prepareImage.js lines 168-169 in composeDownscale: Math.round(...) -> Math.max(1, Math.round(...)) on both axes. Math.max(1, x) is the identity for every x >= 1, so 1200x800, 1201x800, 5000x3000, 32x24 and 1x1 are bit-for-bit unchanged and nothing is upscaled. Aspect ratio is preserved as closely as integer raster dimensions allow; the clamp engages only where the true short edge is below half a pixel. composeSquare and composeNormalize were checked and need no change.
